request.input:
1girl, solo, full body, three-quarter view, looking at viewer, confident smile.

Finished environmental game illustration, arknights, futuristic city.

Wu sits sideways on a low modern observation-terrace bench, both boots resting on the deck, knees together, right hand resting on her lap, left palm on the bench beside her hip. She occupies the left half, her face turned toward us; the city fills the right half. Entire head, hair bow and boots in frame. A low railing leads toward layered towers, elevated transit tracks and distant mountains; light snow along roof edges. No other people.

Winter night, deep blue sky, cool blue ambient light on both figure and terrace, small warm city windows below, a subtle warm reflection on her cheek, distant haze.
